1. Where are the mobile home parks in Aldergrove?
Pioneer Park at 272 Street and 0 Avenue, and Aldergrove Mobile Home Park on Fraser Highway.
2. Is Pioneer Park a pad-rent park?
No. Pioneer Park is a 55+ housing co-op on Matsqui First Nation land. Approved buyers purchase membership shares and pay a monthly pad assessment.
3. Do I need approval to buy in Pioneer Park?
Yes. Buyers are interviewed by the co-op board before the purchase goes ahead.
4. Does Aldergrove Mobile Home Park have an age limit?
Recent listings describe it as having no age restriction. Check the current park rules in writing before you make an offer.
5. How often can pad rent go up?
The Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act allows one increase per year, within a limit the Province sets.
6. What do you check before an offer firms?
A Manufactured Home Registry search with liens, plus the CSA or Technical Safety BC silver label on the home.
7. How is this different from the Langley mobile homes page?
This page shows Aldergrove (F66) mobile homes only. The Langley page covers every park in the Township.
